sections.voiceover: Did you know Chile hosts the 6,893-meter Ojos del Salado and the driest city, Arica?
Ojos del Salado rises 6,893 meters above sea level on the Andes border. Is there any place on Earth drier than the Chilean city of Arica?
But Arica is even more extreme, holding the record as the driest inhabited place on Earth.
The Ojos del Salado volcano covers an area ranging from 70 to 160 square kilometers.
Chile claims the 6,893-meter Ojos del Salado summit and the 0.76-millimeter rainfall record in Arica.
